items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: I was playing in the theater and the symphony band. Uh huh. Just like Bowen.

ctx.x: Well, as far as I know, they always have fourth strings. They always have? Up to mine. But I used to, most of the boys used to take the E string off. Uh huh. Because the finger though, fourth string, most of the, I was playing, I was playing fourth strings, was, I was playing in the theater and the symphony band. Uh huh. Just like Bowen. They bowed. Yeah. And I was in theater. But the man, because of me playing, using the fourth string, Hendrick Kimball. Oh yeah.
